analysis: Examined ProviderLoop.swift head lines 534-1297 and the patch adding `operatorModelFilter` (head 221-224 declaration, 946-948 init). The init seeds the filter as nil when backend.enabledModels is empty, else Set(enabledModels) ∪ config.models ids. This is a local operator restriction on which models the provider converges to/serves (A-018 availability, operator-controlled; ADV-001 already controls config, so no new trust is granted). Doc comment references `operatorFilterAllows` and live-switch updates, whose implementations are not in this batch; a nil filter means 'serve any coordinator-pushed model', matching documented prior behavior. The filter only narrows serving; it does not touch attestation, keyPair, signer selection (createAttestationSigner unchanged at 1232-1262), modelHashes/liveModelHashes, or advertised-set construction (966-985 unchanged). Integration questions: confirm `operatorFilterAllows` is enforced consistently in reconcileDesiredModels, prefetch_model handling, applyVerifiedPrefetch and autopilot paths, and that the union with config.models doesn't cause weight-hash attestation bypass for hotswapped models (modelHashes comment 637-644). Test changes: AutopilotInventoryTests now passes enabledModels including the successor (head 57-59), implying successors outside the filter are no longer converged — a tightening. MockCoordinator adds pushPrefetchModel test helper (head 460-463), test-only. No security regression identified in supplied units.
